questions.text: Availability Commitments & Verification: Please provide a comprehensive analysis of system availability commitments, including: Contractually guaranteed availability levels; Measurement methodologies; Exclusions; Historical performance data; Penalties and remedies.
questions.evidence_required: SLA documentation, Independent verification reports, Historical performance logs

questions.text: End-to-End Reliability Assessment: Describe the complete reliability chain from end-user perspective: Component-level availability; Network connectivity dependencies; Authentication/access success rates; Geographic variations; Real user monitoring data.
questions.evidence_required: Architecture diagrams, RUM data, Network dependency map

questions.text: Performance Quality Metrics: Provide detailed performance quality indicators beyond binary uptime: Response time distributions; Data quality metrics; Transaction success rates; Degradation patterns; User satisfaction scores.
questions.evidence_required: Performance dashboards, Data quality reports, User satisfaction surveys

questions.text: Deployment Environment Characterization: Provide a comprehensive environmental profile for deployment locations: Temperature ranges; Humidity ranges; Dust/corrosive exposure; Solar radiation; Physical stress factors.

Context-Specific Stress Testing: Document comprehensive stress testing under deployment-realistic conditions: Multi-factor stress scenarios; Duration of tests; Population-representative testing; Pass/fail criteria; Independent verification.
questions.evidence_required: Stress test protocols, Independent lab reports, Test results

questions.text: Infrastructure Dependency Resilience: Analyze system resilience to infrastructure variability: Power quality tolerance; Power outage survival; Connectivity tolerance; Supply chain resilience.
questions.evidence_required: Power tolerance specs, Backup capability documentation, Supply chain strategy

questions.text: Standards Compliance Verification: Provide evidence of standards compliance and interoperability: Claimed standards with certification; Scope of certification; Interoperability testing results; API completeness; Version control policies.
questions.evidence_required: Compliance certificates, Interoperability test reports, API documentation

questions.text: Integration Complexity Assessment: Evaluate the practical complexity of system integration: Time/effort for integration; Error rates; Custom code requirements; Support requirements; Performance impact.
questions.evidence_required: Integration case studies, Developer logs, Support ticket analysis

questions.text: Vendor Lock-In Risk Analysis: Assess the risk and cost of vendor dependency: Technology openness; Data portability; Skills transferability; Switching cost quantification; Alternative vendor availability.
questions.evidence_required: Data export documentation, Open standard verification, Switching cost analysis

questions.text: Comprehensive Failure Mode Analysis: Provide detailed Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA): Identification of critical failure modes; Risk Priority Numbers; Single points of failure; Cascading failure scenarios; Historical failure data.
questions.evidence_required: FMEA report, Historical incident logs, Redundancy plans

questions.text: Graceful Degradation Assessment: Demonstrate system behavior under partial failure conditions: Degradation levels defined; Functionality retained; Automatic vs. manual transitions; User experience; Recovery pathways.
questions.evidence_required: Degradation protocols, UX failure state designs, Recovery procedures

questions.text: Recovery Metrics & Capabilities: Provide quantified recovery performance data: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD); Mean Time to Repair (MTTR); Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF); Recovery documentation quality; Disaster recovery capabilities.
questions.evidence_required: MTTD/MTTR/MTBF metrics, Disaster recovery plan, Recovery manuals

scoring_notes: Layer 1 composite formula: Weighted average of sub-dimensions. Critical evidence missing triggers automatic flag.
